notes.title: New Tattoo Tycoon Gameplay - German Indie Showcase
notes.content:
Interested in the newest Tattoo Tycoon gameplay? Then go check out the German Indie Showcase hosted by Gronkh! Our trailer starts at [b][u]9:20[/u][/b]
We are happy and grateful to have been part of this showcase alongside many other amazing indie games.
